valerie.chauvin@umontreal.ca:
Hi Sara, I had an end of participation meeting with one of my participants and he did not receive any notification past August 31, 2024. He started on August 16th and was supposed to get his surveys twice a day for a month (ending on September 16). I am supposed to have a new participant starting tomorrow but I cannot access to release my surveys for now. My license is marked as full, but there seems to have a problem. I do not think that our license was extended as it was supposed to. As reference my study number is 2834. The participant that did not receive all his notifications is AID 100819. I would greatly appreciate a fast return, Thank you, Valérie Valérie Chauvin Étudiante PhD en Sciences de l’activité physique, UdeM, EKSAP Présidente du comité étudiant de l’Association québécoise des sciences de l’activité physique AQSAP Vice-présidente de l’Association étudiante de kinésiologie des cycles supérieurs AEKCS Membre du comité de lecture, Revue de vulgarisation scientifique DIRE------

Sara Farnya:
FYI. I have already sent the initial response in the "Sales" channel. Thank you.Hi Valérie,I hope you're doing well.Thank you for bringing this to my attention. I want to assure you that your license has been extended and the issue should not be related to this matter.Based on your description, it seems that the "Participation Period" for the participants may not have been set correctly, and their end date was set to August 31, 2024. You can review this information on the "Participation" page of your dashboard and adjust their participation period as necessary. I will also forward your message to our support team so they can investigate further.I'm not entirely sure what you mean by not being able to access and release your surveys. It would be helpful if you could provide more details for our team to address when they follow up with you.Best,Sara------
